Create a project

Usage:
  higgsfield project create [flags]

Flags:
      --color string             project folder color (default "Cyan")
      --description string       project description
      --emoji string             project emoji
  -h, --help                     help for create
      --idempotency-key string   stable key for replaying create
      --name string              project name (required)

Global Flags:
      --json               print raw JSON responses
      --no-color           disable color output
      --workspace string   workspace for this request only

Create a folder

Usage:
  higgsfield project folders create <project-id> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for create
      --name string     folder name (required)
      --parent string   parent folder ID (defaults to project root)

Global Flags:
      --json               print raw JSON responses
      --no-color           disable color output
      --workspace string   workspace for this request only

Attach a typed source or upload a local file

Usage:
  higgsfield project assets add <project-id> [flags]

Flags:
      --file string     local file to upload before attaching
      --folder string   destination folder ID; defaults to project root
  -h, --help            help for add
      --source string   typed source ID
      --type string     source type (job, media_input, video_input, audio_input, file_input)

Global Flags:
      --json               print raw JSON responses
      --no-color           disable color output
      --workspace string   workspace for this request only

Manage project assets

Usage:
  higgsfield project assets [command]

Available Commands:
  add            Attach a typed source or upload a local file
  confirm-upload Confirm a completed generic file upload
  copy           Copy an existing project placement
  get            Get placement details
  list           List project assets
  move           Move a placement
  remove         Unlink a placement
  resolve        Resolve an exact typed source to project placements

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for assets

Global Flags:
      --json               print raw JSON responses
      --no-color           disable color output
      --workspace string   workspace for this request only

Use "higgsfield project assets [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Create an image, video, audio, or 3D job.
Pass params as --name value.
Media flags: --image-references, --video-references, --audio-references, --start-image, --end-image.
Short aliases: --image, --video, --audio.
Media flags accept a UUID (upload id or job id) or a local file path — paths are auto-uploaded.
Run `higgsfield model get <job_type>` to inspect accepted params.
Use --wait to block until each job finishes and print the result URL(s).

Usage:
  higgsfield generate create <job_type> [--param value]... [flags]

Examples:
  higgsfield generate create seedance_2_0 --prompt "cinematic product photo" --image-references ./photo.png
  higgsfield generate create <video_model> --prompt "..." --video-references ./reference.mp4 --wait --wait-timeout 20m --wait-interval 5s

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for create

Global Flags:
      --json       print raw JSON responses
      --no-color   disable color output

Create a custom Soul reference

Usage:
  higgsfield soul-id create [flags]

Examples:
  higgsfield soul-id create --name Alice --soul-2 --image ./alice1.png --image ./alice2.jpg --image ./alice3.png --image ./alice4.jpg --image ./alice5.png
  higgsfield soul-id create --name Alice --soul-cinematic --image <upload_id> --image ./alice2.jpg

Flags:
  -h, --help                help for create
      --image stringArray   upload UUID or local image path (repeatable, 5–20)
      --name string         character name (required)
      --soul-2              train Soul 2.0 model
      --soul-cinematic      train Soul Cinematic model

Global Flags:
      --json       print raw JSON responses
      --no-color   disable color output

List voices. Use a voice's id as --voice-id and its Voice Type (preset for built-in voices, element for cloned ones) as --voice-type when running text-to-speech or voice-change.

Usage:
  higgsfield voices [command]

Examples:
  higgsfield voices list
  higgsfield voices list --json
  higgsfield voices get <voice_id>

Available Commands:
  get         Show a single voice
  list        List available voices

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for voices

Global Flags:
      --json       print raw JSON responses
      --no-color   disable color output

Use "higgsfield voices [command] --help" for more information about a command.
